$comment: vcpkg manifest for the host-side tooling. Neither dependency is compiled by this
repo's CMake build - both are declaration-only, on purpose.
fmt is declared BARE (no version constraint), so a scanner has nothing to pin it to.
nlohmann-json is pinned through `overrides`, which is the only place vcpkg records
an exact version. The contrast between the two is the point.
name: nightmare
